A kind of track and field sports game played along a track.

트레이드.definitionKo: 프로 팀 사이에서 선수를 다른 팀으로 옮기거나 서로 바꾸는 일.
트레이드.englishDescription: An act of transferring an athlete to another team or exchanging athletes between professional sports teams.

특진.definitionKo: 종합 병원에서 환자의 요청에 따라 특정한 의사가 진료함.
특진.englishDescription: At a hospital, a special treatment that a patient receives from a specific doctor, on the patient's request.

특진.definitionKo: 뛰어난 공로를 세워 특별히 계급이나 등급이 올라감.

틈.englishDescription: The space forming in between when an object is divided.

팔베개.definitionKo: 팔을 베개처럼 벰. 또는 베개처럼 벤 팔.

팔베개.englishDescription: An act of pillowing one's head on someone's arm; or the arm used in such a manner.

펄쩍.definitionKo: 갑자기 가볍고 힘 있게 뛰어오르거나 날아오르는 모양.
펄쩍.englishDescription: A word describing a sudden, light, and strong act of flying up or jumping.
A word describing one's sudden act of coming to one's senses or being surprised.

해탈.definitionKo: 불교에서, 도를 닦아 마음속의 화, 욕망, 유혹, 괴로움 등에서 벗어남.

해탈.englishDescription: An act of escaping from a state of being bound by anger, desire, tempation, suffering, etc.

핸드백.definitionKo: 여자들이 손에 들거나 한쪽 어깨에 메는 작은 가방.
핸드백.englishDescription: A small bag carried by a woman in one hand or over the shoulder.

핸들.definitionKo: 손으로 어떤 것을 열거나 들거나 붙잡을 수 있도록 덧붙여 놓은 부분.
핸들.englishDescription: The part attached to an object that enables a person to open, lift, or hold it easily.

핸들.definitionKo: 기계나 기구, 자동차 등을 운전하기 위해 손으로 잡는 부분.
핸들.englishDescription: The part held by the hand, which is used for steering a machine, device, automobile, etc.

허둥거리다.definitionKo: 어찌할 줄을 몰라 이리저리 헤매며 다급하게 서두르다.
허둥거리다.englishDescription: To be in a rush, being at a loss what to do and wandering around.

허들.definitionKo: 육상 경기의 장애물 달리기에 쓰는, 나무나 금속으로 만든 기구.
허들.englishDescription: An implement made of wood or metal, used for a track event of jumping hurdles.
An athletic sport in which participants compete by jumping a series of barriers.

허례허식하다.definitionKo: 형편에 맞지 않게 겉만 화려하게 꾸미다.
허례허식하다.englishDescription: To make something showy outwardly only beyond one's means.

현상.definitionKo: 인간이 알아서 깨달을 수 있는, 사물의 모양이나 상태.
현상.englishDescription: An object's form or state perceivable by a human being.

현상.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 모으거나 구하거나 사람을 찾는 일 등에 돈이나 물품 등을 내걺. 또는 그 돈이나 물품.
현상.englishDescription: An act of offering money or other prize in return for recruiting or finding something, or looking for a person; or the money or prize offered.

현숙하다.definitionKo: 여자의 마음이 너그럽고 슬기로우며 행실이 바르다.
현숙하다.englishDescription: A woman being generous, wise and acting properly.

현하.englishDescription: A state of being under the current situation or condition.

혈색.englishDescription: A glow with a tinge of red on one's complexion.
A scarlet red color like that of blood.

협업.definitionKo: 많은 사람들이 힘을 합해서 하는 일.
협업.englishDescription: An act of many people joining forces to get things done.

형기.englishDescription: The period that an offender is required to serve in prison.

형세.englishDescription: The financial condition of one's life.
A situation or state in which things are shaping up.
Vigor or vitality that extends strongly.
A mountain's shape or geography in Korea's system of geomancy, or feng shui.

호황.definitionKo: 매매나 거래에 나타나는 경제 활동 상태가 좋음. 또는 그런 상황.
호황.englishDescription: A state in which economic activities as seen in trade or transactions are strong; or such a situation.

호황.definitionKo: 경제 활동이 보통 이상으로 활발하게 이루어지는 상태.
호황.englishDescription: A state in which economic activities are exceptionally strong.

혼란시키다.englishDescription: To disturb one's mind or spirit.

혼란시키다.definitionKo: 뒤죽박죽이 되게 만들어 어지럽고 질서가 없게 하다.
혼란시키다.englishExpression: confuse; mess  up; put into disorder
혼란시키다.englishDescription: To mix something up to make it chaotic without order.

혼자되다.definitionKo: 부부 가운데 어느 한쪽이 먼저 죽어 홀로 남다.
혼자되다.englishDescription: For a husband or a wife to be left alone after one of them dies first.

혼절하다.definitionKo: 큰 충격이나 고통을 받아 갑자기 정신이 아득하고 어지러워 정신을 잃고 쓰러지다.
혼절하다.englishDescription: To lose consciousness and collapse, feeling dizzy and dazed suddenly due to a great shock or pain.

홀로.englishDescription: Solely, alone or on one's own.

환갑잔치.definitionKo: 사람이 태어난 지 만 육십 년이 되는 예순 번째 생일에 하는 잔치.
환갑잔치.englishDescription: A party held to celebrate one's sixtieth birthday.

활로.definitionKo: 어려움을 이기고 살아 나갈 수 있는 길.
활로.englishDescription: A way to get out of a difficult situation or survive it.

활약하다.englishExpression: be active; perform actively; play an active role

황금 분할.definitionKo: 한 선분을 둘로 나눌 때, 전체에 대한 큰 부분의 비와 큰 부분에 대한 작은 부분의 비가 같도록 나눈 것.
황금 분할.englishDescription: When dividing a line into two, a state of making the ratio of the longer part to the whole, and the smaller part to the longer part the same.

회중시계.englishDescription: A small watch that can be carried in a pocket.

회충.definitionKo: 길이는 15~30센티미터 정도로, 사람 몸의 작은창자에 사는 기생충.
회충.englishDescription: A 15 to 30 centimeter-long-parasite that lives in the small intestines of a human body.

회화하다.englishExpression: talk with; chat with; have a dialogue
회화하다.englishDescription: To meet another face-to-face and talk with him/her.
To talk with another in a foreign language.

획일적.englishDescription: Everything being identical without any differences.

획일적.definitionKo: 모두가 하나와 같아서 다름이 없는 것.
획일적.englishExpression: being uniform; being monolithic; being standardized
획일적.englishDescription: A state in which everything is the same without showing any differences.

횡포.englishDescription: A state of acting as one pleases and being extremely violent.

후회되다.definitionKo: 이전에 자신이 한 일이 잘못임이 깨달아지고 스스로 자신의 잘못을 나무라게 되다.
후회되다.englishDescription: To come to realize that what one did was wrong and reprimand oneself for  having done it.

훤하다.definitionKo: 앞이 탁 트여 매우 넓고 시원스럽다.
훤하다.englishDescription: A view being sweeping and unobstructed.

훤하다.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 내용이나 사정이 확실하고 분명하다.
훤하다.englishDescription: Something being transparent, obvious or quite predictable.
Having an extremely pleasing, neat, attractive appearance.

훤하다.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 대상에 대해 잘 알고 있다.
훤하다.englishDescription: Having an accurate and deep knowledge about a certain task or object.

휘발성.definitionKo: 보통의 온도에서 액체가 기체로 변하여 흩어지는 성질.
휘발성.englishDescription: A quality of a liquid being apt to change into a gas and evaporate at a normal temperature.

흑자.definitionKo: 번 돈이 쓴 돈보다 많아 이익이 생김.
흑자.englishDescription: The amount of profit incurred as a result of spending less than one earns.

흥.definitionKo: 코를 세게 풀거나 콧김을 부는 소리.
흥.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of blowing one's nose hard or letting out breath through the nose.

흥.definitionKo: 비웃거나 아니꼬울 때 코로 내는 소리.
흥.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made through the nose when one laughs at someone or finds something annoying.

흥.definitionKo: 즐거운 감정. 또는 즐거움을 일어나게 하는 감정.
흥.englishDescription: A joyful feeling; or an emotion arousing joy.

희화적.englishExpression: being comical; being humorous; being witty
희화적.englishDescription: A state of being funny and humorous.
